comment: The Fable commit every Fable.Core reference and the `fable` tool pin are built from. Both packages restore from the Xantham Cloudsmith feed. `dotnet fsi tools/fable-fork.fsx -- sync` packs Fable.Core and Fable (the CLI) from it into tools/fable-fork/packages, to push to that feed. Move `ref` and `version` together; `version` names the packages, so a stale one restores the old build from the NuGet cache.

base.comment: The upstream releases the fork's packages are built on, from the fork's CHANGELOGs and Fable.Transforms/Global/Compiler.fs.
